cohort: The study included 1,604,976 childbirth hospitalizations in New Jersey from January 2000 to September 2015.
finding: The study revealed significant racial inequities in cesarean delivery rates in New Jersey, where Black patients had higher odds of cesarean for low-risk deliveries but lower odds for high-risk deliveries compared to White patients.
mod_finding: Black patients experienced racial inequities in cesarean delivery rates, with higher odds of cesarean for low-risk deliveries and lower odds for high-risk deliveries compared to White counterparts.
